text: Being here, I am struck by the intersection of creativity and innovation. The glass-walled room exudes an air of anticipation, promising discussions or presentations that will likely delve into the future of technology. In the exhibit space, surrounded by bold colors and text about research and development, I feel a curious blend of excitement and contemplation. Here, human ingenuity is celebrated, and I feel inspired to reflect on how knowledge evolves and how I, too, am part of this ever-advancing tapestry.
